snip.t: Basal metabolic rate rises about 15–20%; calorie needs rise about 300 kcal a day in the second and third trimester.

Autoimmune stimulation (Graves) → ↑ TSH‑receptor antibodies → ↑ thyroid hormone synthesis & release → ↑ basal metabolic rate, ↑ β‑adrenergic receptor density → tachycardia, heat intolerance, weight loss.
↑ basal metabolic rate → heat production → hyperthermia → protein catabolism → muscle weakness
Severe T₃/T₄ deficiency → ↓ basal metabolic rate → hypothermia → impaired myocardial contractility → bradycardia, low output → tissue hypoxia
Thyroid Hormones (T3 & T4)Increase basal metabolic rate.
